references.label: 20671 block 1
references.quote: 3 ORDINANCE NO. 20671

references.label: 20671 block 3
references.quote: AN ORDINANCE introduced by City Manager Dr. Robert M. Perez, concerning the

references.label: 20671 block 4
references.quote: waiver of permit fees, amending § 14.20.060(i) of the Topeka

references.label: 20671 block 5
references.quote: Municipal Code and repealing original section. 8

references.label: 20671 block 6
references.quote: 9 BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF TOPEKA, KANSAS:

references.label: 20671 block 7
references.quote: Section 1. That section 14.20.060(i), Amendments, Section 109, Fees, of The

references.label: 20671 block 8
references.quote: Code of the City of Topeka, Kansas, is hereby amended to read as follows:

references.label: 20671 block 10
references.quote: (i) Section 109, Fees, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following

references.label: 20671 block 11
references.quote: provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: 20671 block 12
references.quote: 109.1 General. Whenever any person shall erect, construct, enlarge, alter,

references.label: 20671 block 13
references.quote: repair, move, improve, convert or demolish any building or structure, or

references.label: 20671 block 14
references.quote: cause the same to be done, an application shall be made to the development

references.label: 20671 block 15
references.quote: services office. A permit shall not be valid until the fees prescribed by law

references.label: 20671 block 16
references.quote: have been paid, nor shall an amendment to a permit be released until the

references.label: 20671 block 17
references.quote: additional fee has been paid.

references.label: 20671 block 18
references.quote: Exception: Repair or replacement of less than 50 percent (50%) of roof area

references.label: 20671 block 19
references.quote: will not require a roofing permit. Provided, however, repair or replacement of

references.label: 20671 block 20
references.quote: more than 5,000 square feet of any sized roof shall require a roofing permit.

references.label: 20671 block 21
references.quote: 109.2 Permit fees.

references.label: 20671 block 22
references.quote: 109.2.1 The fee for each permit issued for work to be commenced within the

references.label: 20671 block 23
references.quote: City of Topeka boundaries shall be as prescribed by the City’s Fee Schedule

references.label: 20671 block 24
references.quote: based on the total valuation ranges set forth in the Table in 109.7, except as

references.label: 20671 block 25
references.quote: provided in 109.6.

references.label: 20671 block 26
references.quote: 109.2.2 The determination of value or valuation under any of the provisions

references.label: 20671 block 27
references.quote: of this code shall be made by the building official. The value to be used in

references.label: 20671 block 28
references.quote: computing the building permit and building plan review fees shall be the total

references.label: 20671 block 29
references.quote: value of all construction work for which the permit is issued, as well as all

references.label: 20671 block 30
references.quote: finish work, painting, roofing, electrical, plumbing, heating, air conditioning,

references.label: 20671 block 31
references.quote: elevators, fire-extinguishing systems and any other permanent equipment.

references.label: 20671 block 32
references.quote: 109.3 Plan review fees. When submittal documents are required by Section

references.label: 20671 block 33
references.quote: 107, a plan review fee s prescribed by the City’s Fee Schedule shall be paid

references.label: 20671 block 34
references.quote: to the City. The plan review fees specified in this section are separate fees

references.label: 20671 block 35
references.quote: from the permit fees specified in Section 109.2 and are in addition to the

references.label: 20671 block 36
references.quote: permit fees. When submittal documents are incomplete or changed so as to

references.label: 20671 block 37
references.quote: require additional plan review or when the project involves deferred submittal

references.label: 20671 block 38
references.quote: items as defined in Section 107.3.4.1, an additional plan review fee shall be

references.label: 20671 block 39
references.quote: charged as prescribed by the City’s Fee Schedule.

references.label: 20671 block 40
references.quote: 109.4 Expedited plan review. An applicant requesting a plan review by the

references.label: 20671 block 41
references.quote: division of development services may request an expedited plan review.

references.label: 20671 block 42
references.quote: Expedited plan review will be undertaken by qualified development services

references.label: 20671 block 43
references.quote: employees outside of normal working hours and will not interfere with normal

references.label: 20671 block 44
references.quote: plan review procedures or projects which have been submitted for plan

references.label: 20671 block 45
references.quote: review. An applicant seeking expedited plan review will compensate the City

references.label: 20671 block 46
references.quote: at the rate of two times the plan review fee for the expedited plan review.

references.label: 20671 block 47
references.quote: 109.5 Administrative and other inspection fees.

references.label: 20671 block 48
references.quote: 109.5.1 Administrative fees. In addition to the permitting and other fees

references.label: 20671 block 49
references.quote: permitted in this section, the following fees and charges for services shall

references.label: 20671 block 50
references.quote: also apply:

references.label: 20671 block 51
references.quote:
Compliance letter:
Floodplain verifications:
Technology improvement for each permit or license:

references.label: 20671 block 52
references.quote: 109.5.2 Other inspection fees. The following fees shall apply to inspections or

references.label: 20671 block 53
references.quote: certificates of elevators, dumbwaiters, escalators and moving walks:

references.label: 20671 block 54
references.quote:
Annual passenger elevator certificate per unit:	$50.00
Annual freight elevator certificate per unit:	$50.00
Annual escalator certificate per unit:	$35.00
Annual dumbwaiter certificate per unit:	$20.00
Annual access lift certificate per unit:	$20.00
Full load test:	$200.00
Reinspection fee:	$50.00

references.label: 20671 block 55
references.quote: 109.6 Waiver of fees. Building permit fees and plan review fees as required

references.label: 20671 block 56
references.quote: by this section for building projects with a total valuation of five million dollars

references.label: 20671 block 57
references.quote: ($5,000,000.00) or more may be modifiedreduced by the City Manager. to a

references.label: 20671 block 58
references.quote: lesser amount, Any such modificationreduction shall not to exceed twenty-

references.label: 20671 block 59
references.quote: five percent (25%) of the scheduled fees provided the City Manager

references.label: 20671 block 60
references.quote: determinesand must be supported by a determination that the building

references.label: 20671 block 61
references.quote: project encourageswill promote economic development and job creation of

references.label: 20671 block 62
references.quote: jobswithin the City. ModificationsAny reduction of building permit fees and

references.label: 20671 block 63
references.quote: plan review fees which exceeding twenty-five percent (25%) of the scheduled

references.label: 20671 block 64
references.quote: fees shall be approvedrequire approval by resolution of the Governing Body.

references.label: 20671 block 65
references.quote: However, no modificationNotwithstanding the forgoing, no reduction or

references.label: 20671 block 66
references.quote: waiver of building permit fees and plan review fees shall be madepermitted if:

references.label: 20671 block 67
references.quote: 1) the applicant intends to utilizes, or is utilizing, any other availableCity tax

references.label: 20671 block 68
references.quote: incentives and/or, abatement, or economic development program that

references.label: 20671 block 69
references.quote: reduces or rebates ad valorem property tax revenues payable to the City or

references.label: 20671 block 70
references.quote: distributed to the City; or 2) the subject property is exempt from real estate

references.label: 20671 block 71
references.quote: taxation. The fee waiver shall not prohibit the entity from applying for tax

references.label: 20671 block 72
references.quote: incentives from other political and taxing subdivisions of the State.

references.label: 20671 block 73
references.quote: 109.6.1 Building permit and plan review fees for projects identifiedmay be

references.label: 20671 block 74
references.quote: waived for building projects approved by resolution of the Governing Body

references.label: 20671 block 75
references.quote: shall be waived provided and to the extentthat the Joint Economic

references.label: 20671 block 76
references.quote: Development Organization reimburses the City in whole for such waived

references.label: 20671 block 77
references.quote: fees. Fees waived pursuant to this subsection and reimbursed by the Joint

references.label: 20671 block 78
references.quote: Economic Development Organization shall not be deemed a reduction or

references.label: 20671 block 79
references.quote: waiver of fees by the City for purposes of Section 109.6 and shall not affect

references.label: 20671 block 80
references.quote: the project’s eligibility for any tax incentive, abatement, or economic

references.label: 20671 block 81
references.quote: development program, including those that reduce or rebate ad valorem

references.label: 20671 block 82
references.quote: property tax revenues payable to the City, whether offered by the City or any

references.label: 20671 block 83
references.quote: other political and taxing subdivisions of the State.

references.label: 20671 block 84
references.quote: 109.6.2. The City Manager is authorized to consider fee waivers in cases of:

references.label: 20671 block 85
references.quote: (1) emergency situations; and (2) affordable or charitable housing projects

references.label: 20671 block 86
references.quote: where materials and labor are donated.

references.label: 20671 block 88
references.quote: Building Permit Total Valuation Ranges

references.label: 20671 block 90
references.quote: 109.8 Work commencing before permit issuance. Any person who

references.label: 20671 block 91
references.quote: commences any work on a building, structure, electrical, gas, mechanical or

references.label: 20671 block 92
references.quote: plumbing system before obtaining the necessary permits shall be subject to a

references.label: 20671 block 93
references.quote: fee as prescribed by the City’s Fee Schedule that shall be in addition to the

references.label: 20671 block 94
references.quote: required permit fees.

references.label: 20671 block 95
references.quote: 109.9 Related fees. The payment of the fee for the construction, alteration,

references.label: 20671 block 96
references.quote: removal or demolition for work done in connection to or concurrently with the

references.label: 20671 block 97
references.quote: work authorized by a building permit shall not relieve the applicant or holder

references.label: 20671 block 98
references.quote: of the permit from the payment of other fees that are prescribed by law.

references.label: 20671 block 99
references.quote: 109.10 Refunds. The building official is authorized to establish a refund

references.label: 20671 block 100
references.quote: policy.

references.label: 20671 block 101
references.quote: Section 2. That original § 14.20.060(i) of The Code of the City of Topeka,

references.label: 20671 block 102
references.quote: Kansas, is hereby specifically repealed.

references.label: 20671 block 103
references.quote: Section 3. This ordinance shall take effect and be in force from and after its

references.label: 20671 block 104
references.quote: passage, approval and publication in the official City newspaper.

references.label: 20671 block 105
references.quote: Section 4. This ordinance shall supersede all ordinances, resolutions or rules,

references.label: 20671 block 106
references.quote: or portions thereof, which are in conflict with the provisions of this ordinance.

references.label: 20671 block 107
references.quote: Section 5. Should any section, clause or phrase of this ordinance be declared

references.label: 20671 block 108
references.quote: invalid by a court of competent jurisdiction, the same shall not affect the validity of this

references.label: 20671 block 109
references.quote: ordinance as a whole, or any part thereof, other than the part so declared to be invalid.

references.label: 20671 block 110
references.quote: PASSED AND APPROVED by the Governing Body on July 14, 2026.
